candidates.source_name: Veřejný rejstřík a Sbírka listin (Obchodní rejstřík) — or.justice.cz
candidates.why_relevant: Legally authoritative record of every change of statutory body (představenstvo, dozorčí rada, jednatel), prokura, branch (odštěpný závod) and registered-office change for CZ banks, payment institutions and fintech s.r.o./a.s. Each entry carries exact 'zapsáno dne' and 'den vzniku/zániku funkce' dates, which is the ground truth for confirming or contradicting press claims about leadership moves.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login; session/URL-token based UI
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 304/2013 Sb. (zákon o veřejných rejstřících)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the bulk open-data feed (dataor.justice.cz) for diffing; use the UI only for targeted 'úplný výpis' pulls per IČO. Diff successive full extracts per watchlist IČO to detect statutory-body deltas.
queries_used: obchodní rejstřík změna člena statutárního orgánu banka sbírka listin justice.cz

candidates.source_name: Veřejný rejstřík a evidence — nový portál MSp (verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Successor portal to or.justice.cz being rolled out by the Ministry of Justice; offers advanced search (rozšířené vyhledávání) across public registers, including search by person — the key capability for tracking an individual executive across multiple bank/fintech entities. Has an EN interface.
candidates.access_status: public, free
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor for URL/schema migration away from or.justice.cz; use person-name advanced search for executive-career tracking; check whether it exposes a stable API before building scrapers.
queries_used: obchodní rejstřík změna člena statutárního orgánu banka sbírka listin justice.cz

candidates.source_name: Sbírka listin (document collection of the commercial register)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory deposit of the underlying documents: rozhodnutí o volbě/jmenování/odvolání členů statutárního orgánu, zápisy z valné hromady, stanovy, projekt fúze/rozdělení, výroční zprávy. Since the 2024 přeměny amendment, merger projects and creditor warnings are deposited HERE rather than published in Obchodní věstník — making Sbírka listin the primary early-warning channel for CZ bank/fintech restructuring, typically ~1 month before approval.
candidates.access_status: public, free; documents are scanned/native PDFs, often image-only requiring OCR
candidates.legal_status: public register; mandatory publication under law
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the Sbírka listin listing per watchlist IČO for new document rows (type + date), download PDFs, OCR the scans, and extract named persons/roles/dates. Prioritise document types 'rozhodnutí o volbě/jmenování', 'projekt přeměny', 'stanovy'.
queries_used: justice.cz sbírka listin platební instituce změna jednatele

candidates.source_name: Otevřená data veřejných rejstříků (dataor.justice.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Bulk machine-readable (XML) exports of the full public registers, published in full scope since 2019 with periodic/incremental updates. This is the only scalable way to run automated diffing of statutory-body membership across the whole CZ banking/payments population without scraping the UI.
candidates.access_status: public, free bulk download; large files
candidates.legal_status: open data published by Ministry of Justice
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled download of full + incremental XML dumps, load into a local store keyed by IČO, and compute person-role deltas run-over-run. Read the published user manual (ISVR_OpenData_Uzivatelska_prirucka.pdf) for schema.
queries_used: dataor.justice.cz otevřená data obchodní rejstřík XML dump justice

candidates.source_name: ARES — Administrativní registr ekonomických subjektů (web UI)
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry of Finance aggregator over the source registers (OR, RŽP, RES, registr plátců DPH). Single lookup by IČO/name returning identity, NACE, legal form and statutory-body data including start/end dates of each function. Fastest way to resolve a company name from press to a canonical IČO before pulling the register record.
candidates.access_status: public, free; query-rate limits apply
candidates.legal_status: state information system, terms of operation published
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as the entity-resolution layer: name -> IČO. Then hand off to the REST API for structured pulls.

Useful for building a full CZ banking/payments entity universe (by NACE 64/66) rather than only monitoring a known watchlist — i.e. discovering subsidiaries and SPVs nobody has on the list.

candidates.source_name: Obchodní věstník (ov.gov.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Official gazette carrying register entries, notices to creditors, convocations of valná hromada, liquidations and historically merger notices for CZ companies including banks and payment institutions. Full-text searchable by company name/IČO with publication dates — a dated, citable corroboration layer alongside the register itself. Note the domain migrated from ov.justice.cz to ov.gov.cz.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Saved full-text queries per watchlist company name and per generic terms ('valná hromada', 'likvidace', 'projekt fúze'); poll the results listing for new publication numbers/dates.

candidates.source_name: Insolvenční rejstřík ISIR (isir.justice.cz / eisir.justice.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory insolvency register; courts must publish within 7 days of proceedings starting, with continuous publication of decisions and submissions. For A5 this is the distress-side signal: fintech/payment-firm failures, forced management change, appointment of insolvenční správce — i.e. the most abrupt form of 'organization change' and a leading indicator of team availability on the CZ market. eisir.justice.cz is the newer front end.
candidates.access_status: public, free online access
candidates.legal_status: public register operated by Ministry of Justice
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Lustrace by IČO for the watchlist on a weekly cadence; ISIR has historically offered a web service / notification interface worth evaluating over UI scraping.

candidates.source_name: Evidence skutečných majitelů (ESM) — esm.justice.cz
candidates.why_relevant: Beneficial-ownership register — historically the way to see who really controls a CZ payment institution or fintech SPV. CRITICAL STATUS CHANGE: the Ministry of Justice closed the public part and the ESM open data on 17 December 2025; access now requires datová schránka (own extract), JIP/privileged remote access for public authorities, or a formal request. Track it as a degraded/legally-restricted source, and rely on register ownership data plus commercial aggregators' historical ESM snapshots instead.
candidates.access_status: public part disabled since 2025-12-17; restricted access only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape. Use pre-Dec-2025 archived/aggregator copies for history; for current data rely on lawful request routes or on ownership data still visible in the commercial register.

negative_findings.description: The public part of the Evidence skutečných majitelů (esm.justice.cz) and its open data were made inaccessible by the Ministry of Justice on 17 December 2025.
negative_findings.result_summary: MSp announcement and FAU summary confirm public access and open data withdrawal; remaining access is via datová schránka for one's own extract, JIP for public authorities, or formal request.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Beneficial-ownership tracing of CZ payment institutions and fintech SPVs can no longer be done openly. Any A5 workflow that assumed ESM as a free ownership layer must be redesigned around commercial-register ownership data and pre-2026 archived ESM snapshots.

negative_findings.description: The amended Czech law on přeměny (transformations) removed the requirement to publish merger notices in Obchodní věstník; merger projects and creditor warnings are now deposited into the Sbírka listin at least one month before approval.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed across multiple CZ legal commentaries (epravo.cz, matidal.cz) surfaced by the Obchodní věstník query.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring Obchodní věstník alone will now MISS bank/fintech restructurings. The Sbírka listin document feed must be the primary M&A/restructuring early-warning channel for CZ.

negative_findings.description: Two register domains appear to be migrating: Obchodní věstník results now resolve under ov.gov.cz (seed assumed ov.justice.cz), and a new public-register portal verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz is running alongside or.justice.cz.
negative_findings.result_summary: Live search results returned ov.gov.cz record URLs and verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz search pages; the legacy ov.ihned.cz mirror also still appears.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any hardcoded collector URLs against ov.justice.cz or or.justice.cz carry migration risk; a URL-stability check should be part of the recurring pipeline rather than a one-off.

negative_findings.description: No statutory register source was found that records non-statutory HIRING — i.e. ordinary staff appointments, headcount, or department reorganisations below the statutory-body/prokura level.
negative_findings.result_summary: CZ registers cover only legally registered particulars: statutory body members, prokuristé, branch heads, ownership, registered office. Rank-and-file hiring simply is not a registrable fact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'jobs' and 'hiring' topics of this run cannot be served from this cell. They must come from job boards, LinkedIn, and press cells; this cell should be scoped to leadership moves and organisation/legal-entity changes only.

negative_findings.description: Merk.cz was named in the cell scope but was not independently confirmed by fetch in this pass; its access model, API availability and pricing are assumed, not observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Aggregator search surfaced Kurzy.cz, Peníze.cz, Finmag.cz and sledovani-insolvence.cz but did not return a Merk.cz result page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Its candidate record carries a deliberately reduced confidence_score; the verification pass should treat it as a priority liveness/capability check before any procurement decision.

negative_findings.description: The cell scope names 'ÚVIS' as a register source; no CZ register of that name relevant to corporate filings was found. ÚVIS (Úřad pro veřejné informační systémy) was abolished in the 2000s and its functions absorbed into the Ministry of Informatics/Interior.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches within this cell surfaced ISIR (insolvency) but nothing matching an active 'ÚVIS' filing register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The scope term is likely a stale artefact or a conflation with ISIR; the run definition should be corrected so a downstream collector does not chase a non-existent portal.

coverage_gaps.description: Regulator-side registers that complement the commercial register were not covered here: ČNB's seznam regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů (list of banks, payment institutions, small-scale payment service providers, e-money issuers) and the ČNB fit-and-proper approvals of senior management.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign or cross-check a cell for cnb.cz register exports; a ČNB licence-status change is often the earliest signal of an entity restructuring, and ČNB approval of a board member frequently PRE-DATES the commercial-register entry.

coverage_gaps.description: CZ branches of foreign banks (odštěpný závod zahraniční osoby) and EU passported payment institutions have thin CZ register footprints; their real org changes are filed in the home-state register (e.g. AT, DE, SK) or the EBA register.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a cell covering the EBA payment-institutions register and home-state registers, plus the SK ORSR for the frequent CZ/SK twin structures.

coverage_gaps.description: All findings in this slice come from search-result metadata and snippets; no page was fetched and parsed end-to-end, so schema details (ARES field names, dataor.justice.cz file structure, whether verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz exposes an API) remain unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical spike that fetches the ARES Swagger spec and one dataor.justice.cz dump to confirm the statutory-body field structure before pipeline design.

coverage_gaps.description: The lag between a real leadership change and its register entry is not quantified. Law says 'bez zbytečného odkladu', but court processing adds weeks, and 'den vzniku funkce' can be backdated relative to 'zapsáno dne'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Empirically measure the distribution of (zapsáno dne − den vzniku funkce) on a sample of CZ bank filings, and always store BOTH dates so downstream analysis never conflates event date with filing date.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is inherently thin — the primary sources are Czech-only, with only partial EN interfaces (verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz/en, ARES). No EN-language equivalent of the Sbírka listin exists.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept CS as the mandatory working language for this cell and budget OCR + CS-language document extraction; do not expect EN sourcing to substitute.

coverage_gaps.description: Major commercial CZ corporate-data vendors were not surveyed: Cribis (CRIF), Dun & Bradstreet/Bisnode CZ, Albertina, and Rejstrik-Firem.cz. These typically offer the lowest-latency change alerts and cleaned person-entity resolution.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up vendor sweep comparing latency, API quality and licence terms against the free dataor.justice.cz + ARES stack before committing to a build-vs-buy decision.

brief: The CZ statutory-filing layer is unusually strong for A5: every change of statutory body, prokura, branch or registered office is legally mandated, dated twice (den vzniku funkce vs. zapsáno dne), and available both through the official UI (or.justice.cz, migrating to verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz) and as bulk open data (dataor.justice.cz) plus a documented ARES REST API — so a diff-based org-change monitor can be built without scraping. Two structural changes reshape the landscape: the přeměny amendment moved merger projects and creditor warnings out of Obchodní věstník into the Sbírka listin (making the document collection, not the gazette, the M&A early-warning channel), and the Ministry of Justice closed the public Evidence skutečných majitelů and its open data on 17 December 2025, removing free beneficial-ownership tracing. Commercial aggregators (Kurzy.cz relationship graphs, Peníze.cz, Merk, sledovani-insolvence.cz) and the NGO platform Hlídač státu add value chiefly as pointer and alerting layers — person-to-entity pivots that reveal unknown subsidiaries and SPVs — but every lead they generate must be confirmed against the official register. The cell cannot serve 'jobs'/'hiring' at all: CZ registers record only registrable legal facts, not staff-level recruitment.
